title: Mahabharat — The Weight of Dharma
style_lock: Photoreal film still, ARRI Alexa 35, 65mm Zeiss Supreme, 1/48s, Kodak Vision3 500T; deep indigo and torch amber, hard edge key from screen-left, everything else two stops down; 9:16 vertical

episodes.location_text: Hastinapur throne hall interior: carved sandstone pillars, deep teal drapes, brass lamps, warm dawn shafts

shots.frame: wide establishing, king small on the peacock throne, pillars receding into warm haze
extreme close-up on the king's blind milky eyes, shallow depth, gold crown edge in frame
medium close-up, Krishna in the left third, throne room soft behind

beats.action: holds, weight settled, eyes past the king
one breath, jewellery shifts a hair, nothing else
holds to the end, no cut
